from flask import Flask, request
from database import db

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route('/book_logs', methods=['POST'])
def book_logs():
    user = request.form['user']
    book = request.form['book']
    comments = request.form['comments']

    cursor = db.cursor()
    query = "INSERT INTO book_logs (user, book, comments) VALUES (%s, %s, %s)"
    cursor.execute(query, (user, book, comments))
    db.commit()

    return "Log added!"

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run()
